title: Tiny, cute key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.12'/>
  
  <!-- Key bow (handle) - top circle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='12' fill='#FFBF00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='7' fill='#FFE066'/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on the bow -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='27' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#7B4F00'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='27' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#7B4F00'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='26' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 33 Q50 37 55 33' stroke='#7B4F00' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x='46' y='46' width='8' height='30' rx='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='47' width='5' height='28' rx='2' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x='54' y='62' width='12' height='7' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='54' y='62' width='12' height='3.5' rx='2' fill='#FFBF00'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='9' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='9' height='3' rx='2' fill='#FFBF00'/>
  
  <!-- Small decorative keyring hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3' fill='#5C3D00' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2' fill='#3D2800'/>
  
  <!-- Cute sparkles around key -->
  <path d='M22 22 L24 18 L26 22 L24 26 Z' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M78 70 L80 66 L82 70 L80 74 Z' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M75 20 L76.5 17 L78 20 L76.5 23 Z' fill='#FFBF00' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M20 75 L21.5 72 L23 75 L21.5 78 Z' fill='#FFBF00' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
